trans-unit.source: How to delete your Isomantika account and all your data in it.
trans-unit.target: Cómo eliminar tu cuenta de Isomantika y todos sus datos.

trans-unit.note: Section heading: deleting from the app

trans-unit.source: Open Isomantika and go to Settings.
trans-unit.target: Abre Isomantika y ve a Ajustes.
trans-unit.note: Step 1; «Settings» is the tab name in the app

trans-unit.source: In the Account section, tap Delete account.
trans-unit.target: En la sección Cuenta, toca Eliminar cuenta.
trans-unit.note: Step 2; «Account» and «Delete account» must match the app

trans-unit.source: On iPhone and iPad, if you signed in with Apple, the app will then ask you to confirm with Apple: this disconnects the app from your Apple ID.
trans-unit.target: En iPhone y iPad, si iniciaste sesión con Apple, la app te pedirá después que confirmes con Apple: así se desvinculará de tu Apple ID.
trans-unit.note: Note for users who signed in with Apple

trans-unit.source: Your account and all your readings are deleted immediately and permanently. This can't be undone.
trans-unit.target: Tu cuenta y todas tus lecturas se eliminan de inmediato y para siempre. No se puede deshacer.

trans-unit.source: What else we keep and for how long — see the Privacy Policy
trans-unit.target: Qué más conservamos y durante cuánto tiempo: consulta la Política de privacidad

trans-unit.source: Answers to common questions about the app.
trans-unit.target: Respuestas a las preguntas frecuentes sobre la aplicación.

trans-unit.note: Heading of the questions list, for screen readers

trans-unit.source: Write to us — we reply by email.
How many readings can I do per day?
Why do I need to sign in?
Your readings and history are stored in your account, so they are not lost when you change or reinstall your phone, and daily limits are counted per account. You can sign in with Google or Apple.
trans-unit.target: Tus lecturas y tu historial se guardan en tu cuenta, así que no se pierden si cambias o reinstalas el teléfono, y los límites diarios se cuentan por cuenta. Puedes iniciar sesión con Google o Apple.

trans-unit.source: Where can I find my past readings?
In the History tab. Every reading is saved there automatically.
trans-unit.target: En la pestaña Historial. Cada lectura se guarda allí automáticamente.
trans-unit.note: Answer; «History» is the tab name in the app

trans-unit.source: How do I remove a reading from history?
In History, swipe the reading away and confirm. Removing a reading doesn't give back a reading for today.
trans-unit.target: En Historial, desliza la lectura y confirma. Esto no devuelve una lectura para hoy.
trans-unit.note: Answer about removing a reading from history

trans-unit.source: How do I delete my account?
Open Settings → Account → Delete account. Your account and all your readings are deleted immediately and permanently.
trans-unit.target: Abre Ajustes → Cuenta → Eliminar cuenta. Tu cuenta y todas tus lecturas se eliminan de inmediato y para siempre.
trans-unit.note: Answer; «Settings → Account → Delete account» must match the app menu

trans-unit.source: Isomantika is a tarot app for iOS and Android. You ask a question, pick one of 12 spreads, draw cards from the original 1909 Rider–Waite deck, and AI writes an interpretation of the spread for your question — in English, Russian or Spanish.
trans-unit.target: Isomantika es una app de tarot para iOS y Android. Haces una pregunta, eliges una de las 12 tiradas, sacas cartas de la baraja original Rider-Waite de 1909 y la IA escribe una interpretación de la tirada para tu pregunta, en español, inglés o ruso.

trans-unit.source: How do I change the language, theme or card back?
trans-unit.target: ¿Cómo cambio el idioma, el tema o el reverso de las cartas?

trans-unit.source: Open Settings → Appearance. There you can choose the language (System, English, Russian or Spanish), the theme (Dark, Light or System) and one of five card back designs.
trans-unit.target: Abre Ajustes → Apariencia. Allí puedes elegir el idioma (del sistema, español, inglés o ruso), el tema (oscuro, claro o del sistema) y uno de los cinco diseños del reverso.
trans-unit.note: Answer; «Settings → Appearance» must match the app menu
